snippet.title: Shards of Mistfrost - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The giants of Calamity appeared together with winter crystals. Their goal is to make the entire world ruled by snow and ice, with the winter crystals generating an eternal and neverending cold weather. But before they can execute their plan, our hero Hrok Thorgril sets on a journey with his trusty axe, hoping to destroy every winter crystal and defeat every giant before it's too late.

Shards of Mistfrost is a 2d action adventure platformer with a norse mythology aesthetic and retro gameplay. The game's main mechanic is the weapon, an axe that must be thrown to destroy obstacles, winter crystals and enemies, but the player must wait the axe return to their hands. Positioning, quick reflexes and good map awareness are key points to conquer all levels
